lenses.summary: For core ELA, three nationally scaled vendors carry EdReports all-green ratings: HMH Into Reading (2020 review), Great Minds Arts & Letters (July 2026), and Amplify CKLA. Social studies is a two-way race between inquirED and TCI, while Teaching Strategies only fits PreK and K. inquirED shows the thinnest public proof: no reach numbers, no pricing, and a 2022 New Mexico state review that scored it below the adoption cutoff, partly offset by an Oregon "Exemplary" designation it reports and a free district pilot.

lenses.summary: An ELA director gets the most verifiable detail from Into Reading, Arts & Letters, and CKLA, which all have scored EdReports reports; Arts & Letters has the newest, but its core does not claim foundational skills, which are sold separately or bundled with partner programs. A social studies director comparing inquirED and TCI sees similar inquiry and literacy claims, but TCI offers open samples and public prices. inquirED's integrated Inkwell block is distinctive, yet a September 2026 job post shows its foundational literacy component is still being designed.

lenses.sources_summary: The three ELA vendors can be compared on EdReports scores, though Amplify's publicly findable report covers an older edition. Social studies has no EdReports-style common yardstick, so inquirED and TCI rely on state designations and a single Learning List review. The most decision-relevant inquirED fact for an ELA director came from a job posting, not product documentation.
